verdicts.reason: Both pull the Meridian logo out of the blue panel so it straddles the panel edge over busy sky/sea. Both shrink the 'Find a Fare' CTA to an illegible pill, and the sunglasses end up as a cropped fragment jammed under the panel's bottom-left corner. A spaces things a little better, with the headline given room and a 2-line subhead; B's 3-line subhead is nearly as large as the headline, so the hierarchy competes, and it crowds the CTA toward the bottom of the panel.
